limitations: This collection covers Compliance circulars on levy of damages (14B) and interest (7Q), enquiries under section 7A (2007-2025) and the 2026 arrangements under the Code on Social Security, 2020 (VISHWAS 2026 and authorised officers). Recovery, panel advocates, court-case handling and exemption matters are in other collections.
Waiver-of-damages requests for individual mills, judgments forwarded to offices and committee minutes are not included.

The 2007 arrangement of powers and its 2009 and 2012 partial modifications fix thresholds for officers handling 7A cases; later circulars on jurisdiction (2017, 2022) continue the subject without a stated link in the text checked, so those links are unverified.

The 2020 circular on initiation of 7A inquiries is issued 'in supersession of the earlier instructions' without naming them, and the 2012-2016 quasi-judicial guidelines are continued but not stated to be withdrawn; no supersession is asserted between them. Whether the 2007 arrangement and the 2009-2012 circulars were later replaced is not stated.

The 2026 circulars apply sections 125 and 128 of the Code on Social Security, 2020; whether they replace the 7A and 14B instructions for proceedings under the 1952 Act is not stated, so the supersession link is unverified.

Rates of damages: the 2009 revision (Para 32A) and the 2024 amendment of the Pension Scheme are listed, but the rate tables should be read from the page; the 2025 amendments of sections 14AC and 14B are in force from the Gazette date stated (29 October 2025).
Dates of two 2008-2009 circulars are blank or partly legible in the scan; they follow the issuer listing.
Dates follow the letter, not the issuer listing; entries whose letter date differs carry a date_note.

PDFs were read from the issuer mirror on 4 November 2026 because the public site returned 404 for these paths; recorded SHA-256 values apply to those files. Scanned pages are OCR. Issue dates were checked against the document headers.
